title: Currency Ledger
author: Codex
thesis: Keep currency, token and collateral identities visible from browse to review.
tradeoff: The clearest general-purpose direction; less room for an advanced dealing view.

title: One Thing
author: Codex
thesis: Ask one question at a time. Keep a short path from intent to review.
tradeoff: Best for new users; repeat operators need more steps.

title: Balance Sheet
author: Codex
thesis: Explain the market as two separate books: the LP pool and the user's loan.
tradeoff: Strong accounting clarity; needs testing with users new to balance sheets.

title: Dealing Room
author: Codex
thesis: Make units and quote terms scan as quickly as a compact dealing ticket.
tradeoff: Fast for frequent users; its information density is less forgiving.

title: Pocket
author: Codex
thesis: Start with what the user owns, then expose only the next useful action.
tradeoff: Friendly on a phone; public market comparison is a second step.

title: Health Desk
author: Codex
thesis: Put debt risk before borrowing capacity without assigning risk to LP shares.
tradeoff: Good for Mint; risk framing can distract users who only want liquidity.

title: Liquidity Sheet
author: Codex
thesis: Make available and locked collateral the visual centre of the market.
tradeoff: Best for LP decisions; token swapping is deliberately quieter.

title: Flow Map
author: Codex
thesis: Show what moves between wallet, pool and loan before asking for a signature.
tradeoff: Strong teaching tool; arrows must not imply a guaranteed execution route.

title: Plain Sight
author: Codex
thesis: Use precise sentences and small tables instead of a dashboard of cards.
tradeoff: Low visual noise; a quieter identity may be less memorable.

title: Settlement Tape
author: Codex
thesis: Treat provenance, state and review as a legible operational record.
tradeoff: Best for audit and Buffer work; more context than casual users need.

title: Meridian
author: Codex
thesis: Make exchanging, supplying and borrowing three clear moves in one confident currency workspace.
tradeoff: A strong general-purpose product; the side-by-side hierarchy needs careful mobile stacking.

title: Parity
author: Codex
thesis: Treat every operation as a readable equation with exact units and almost no interface furniture.
tradeoff: Very fast to scan; its strict visual language may feel austere.

title: Arc
author: Codex
thesis: Give currency exchange a focused night-mode ticket, with route and consequence adjacent to the amounts.
tradeoff: A distinctive dark experience; all status and secondary copy must retain contrast.

title: Civic
author: Codex
thesis: Present markets as a public financial record before asking anyone to create a position.
tradeoff: Excellent for trust through explanation; less compact for a frequent trader.

title: Current
author: Codex
thesis: Use physical liquidity and labelled flows as the organizing language across every task.
tradeoff: Clear for LP decisions; movement diagrams must not suggest an execution guarantee.

title: Aperture
author: Codex
thesis: Build a measured financial instrument with source, units and consequences aligned on one grid.
tradeoff: Powerful for analytical users; the density is not the best first-time experience.

title: Forma
author: Codex
thesis: Guide the user through choose, inspect and review without disguising missing execution data as progress.
tradeoff: Makes consequences easy to follow; routine users may prefer a shorter route.

title: Harbor
author: Codex
thesis: Begin with the user's own claim, then give borrowing and liquidity separate homes.
tradeoff: A welcoming personal view; public pool context must remain accessible.

title: Quartz
author: Codex
thesis: Make amount, asset and unit one precise visual grammar across swap, debt and LP claims.
tradeoff: Strong numerical clarity; the compressed typography needs small-screen testing.

title: Alto
author: Codex
thesis: Create a bright native-app rhythm with a single dominant action and a restrained summary above it.
tradeoff: Approachable and familiar; it needs distinctive content rather than extra decoration.
